entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to start a return. Order number is 88-145-23.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Velo-Aero helmet. Can you tell me what the issue is?
There's no issue. The color is not what I expected. I just need a return label. The box is still unopened.
I understand. And just to confirm, this is a preference regarding the color, not a defect or a safety concern with the helmet itself, correct?
Correct. Look, can I return it or not? I don't have a lot of time.

Yes, absolutely. I'm just confirming the details. I see here the delivery was 29 days ago. Since the box is unopened, there's no question about its safety integrity. Our standard return policy is 90 days, so you are well within the window.
Great. So you're sending the label?
Yes. I've just initiated the return authorization. You'll receive an email with the prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
